text:
In TextOS, an article is marked ready only after it has passed the brief check; otherwise it is stopped with a status that says the brief was not fulfilled. The blocked result lists the missing sections, the required points left uncovered and whether the target query was addressed. That turns a vague verdict of not good enough into a short list that a writer or an editor can work through.

The brief check, the fact-check, the approved sources and the human decision apply in the same way whichever writer produced the draft. Switching the AI model behind the writing does not change what a draft has to deliver against its brief.
